c: Warm milk to 32 °C; add culture; ripen 1 h; add calcium chloride and diluted rennet; set 45 min.
Cut 2 cm; rest 10 min; stir gently 20 min; ladle into perforated moulds; turn after 1 h, then every 2 h.
Next day cut blocks 8 cm; dry-salt all sides; rest 24 h at 12–14 °C.
Submerge in brine; mature 0–4 °C minimum 3 weeks.
Boil, cool to 4 °C; calcium and acid stop the cheese softening in the brine.
33263b47.al: 7 Milk (sheep's milk, goat's milk, mesophilic culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Make and stretch the curd as for fresh mozzarella (32 °C set, 42 °C cook, 80 °C stretch).
Keep 120 g stretched curd aside for the filling; stretch the rest into 6 × 60 g discs, 2 mm thick.
Shred the reserved curd into fine strands; mix with cold cream and salt.
Spoon 60 g into each disc; gather edges, twist and pinch closed; trim.
Rest in ice water 10 min; store in 1% brine; serve at 12–14 °C.
b6efc084.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 35%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Cut cold butter into 2 cm slabs on a tray over a second tray of ice.
Cold-smoke in a smoker or with a smoking gun under a lid 30–45 min at <25 °C, turning once.
Rest wrapped 2 h for the smoke to even out.
Beat with smoked salt until smooth; pipe rosettes or shape logs; 25 g portions.
a939ec9c.al: 7 Milk (butter 82%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Beat butter until pale; fold in chopped parsley, garlic paste, zest, juice and seasoning.
Pound anchovies to a paste; fold in with chopped capers and shallots; no extra salt.
Beat butter with miso and honey until smooth; fold in chives.
For all three: roll into 4 cm logs in parchment; chill firm; slice 25 g discs.
d5554320.st: Logs 0–3 °C 7 days; frozen −18 °C 2 months; slice from frozen.
d5554320.al: 4 Fish (anchovy fillets) · 6 Soybeans (white miso) · 7 Milk (butter). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Warm milk to 30 °C; add calcium chloride and culture; ripen 1 h.
Add diluted rennet; set 4–5 h to pH 4.8–4.9 and a clean break.
Cut 1.5 cm cubes; rest 10 min; heat slowly to 50 °C over 60 min, stirring gently, until curds are firm.
Drain; wash in cold, then ice water to stop acid and firm the curd; drain well.
Fold cream and salt through the cold curd; adjust; pack.
7437ff29.st: 0–3 °C, covered, 4 days; label date and batch.
7437ff29.al: 7 Milk (milk 1.5%, mesophilic culture, cream 20%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Warm milk and cream to 22 °C; add culture; rest 2 min; stir; add 1 drop-dose diluted rennet.
Cover; ferment 20–22 °C 12 h to a firm set.
Ladle into cloth; drain 8–12 h at 0–3 °C until thick.
Blend smooth with salt in a food processor 1 min; pack.
0c3b01d0.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 35%, mesophilic culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Warm cream to 25 °C; stir in cultured buttermilk (or 0.5 g mesophilic culture).
Cover with cloth; culture at 22–24 °C 18–24 h until thick and pleasantly sour (pH 4.6).
Stir once; chill 6 h to set firmer; pack.
09dab246.al: 7 Milk (cream 35%, buttermilk). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Warm cream to 20 °C; add culture; ferment 18–20 h at 20 °C; chill to 10–12 °C overnight (crystallises the fat).
Whip cream in a mixer with the guard on, medium speed, past whipped until it breaks into grains; drain buttermilk (keep, label for baking/brines).
Wash grains 3 × with ice water until the water runs clear (removes buttermilk, longer shelf life).
Knead out water on a cold marble; work in salt for salted butter.
Shape into 25 g portions or 250 g logs; wrap in parchment.
987f0df2.al: 7 Milk (cream 35%, mesophilic culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Warm milk to 22 °C; add culture; rest 2 min; stir; add 1 drop-dose diluted rennet; stir 30 s.
Ferment covered 20–22 °C 18–24 h to a firm lactic set, pH 4.5.
Ladle into a cloth; hang to drain 6–8 h at 18–20 °C.
Mix in salt; roll 3 logs × 215 g.
Ash log: dust evenly with sieved ash; herb log: roll in chopped chives, thyme and cracked pepper; third log plain.
Wrap in paper; mature 2 days at 4 °C before cutting 50 g.
dd630d52.al: 7 Milk (goat's milk, mesophilic culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Dissolve citric acid in 100 g cold water; stir into cold milk with calcium chloride; heat to 32 °C.
Add rennet diluted in 50 g water; stir 30 s; rest 5–10 min for a clean break.
Cut curd 2 cm; heat slowly to 42 °C, stirring; ladle curds into a sieve; drain.
Stretch: dip curds in 80 °C salted whey or water (gloves) until glossy and elastic; do not overwork.
Shape 125 g balls; drop into ice water 10 min; store in light brine (1%).
05565893.st: In 1% brine 0–3 °C 2 days; best same day.
05565893.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Warm milk to 22 °C; add calcium chloride, then sprinkle culture; rest 2 min; stir 1 min.
Add 1 drop-dose rennet (diluted in 30 g water); stir gently 30 s.
Cover; ferment at 20–22 °C 12–14 h to a soft set, pH 4.6.
Ladle into a cloth-lined sieve; drain at 0–3 °C 6–8 h (quark: 10 h).
Whisk smooth with salt (omit for desserts); pack.
a16c4be3.st: 0–3 °C, covered, 4 days; label date and batch.
a16c4be3.al: 7 Milk (milk 1.5%, mesophilic culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Melt butter slowly over low heat; skim foam.
Clarified: stop as soon as solids settle; ladle off clear fat; discard milk solids and water.
Ghee: keep at a gentle simmer 20–25 min until solids turn light gold and the fat is clear and nutty; strain through cloth.
Cook butter in a wide pan over medium heat, whisking, until solids are hazelnut brown and it smells nutty, 6–8 min.
Pour at once into a cold container to stop cooking; keep the browned solids (flavour) or strain for clear use.
d43e7a08.st: Ghee airtight ambient 2 months; clarified and noisette 0–3 °C 1 month.
d43e7a08.al: 7 Milk (butter 82%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Warm milk to 34 °C; add calcium chloride and diluted rennet; set 40 min to a clean break.
Cut 1 cm; stir 20 min while heating to 40 °C; drain into a cloth-lined mould; press 3 kg 1 h.
Cut pressed curd into 4 slabs; poach in the whey at 90 °C until they float, ~15 min.
Drain; while warm, sprinkle with salt from the brine and dried chopped mint; fold each slab in half.
Cool; store in brine (see BRINE) or vacuum-pack.
Dissolve salt in cooled whey or water (10%); submerge halloumi.
0d80946e.al: 7 Milk (sheep's milk, milk 3%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment. Vegetarian only with microbial rennet.

c: Roll drained chèvre into 25 g balls with oiled gloves (2 per portion); chill firm 1 h.
Roll half in crushed pink peppercorns, half in thyme.
Layer balls in a sterilised jar with sliced garlic (blanched 1 min), zest and herbs.
Serve at room temperature with grilled bread; 10 g oil per portion.
501c49b0.st: Covered in oil 0–3 °C 10 days; keep fully submerged.
501c49b0.al: 7 Milk (goat cheese). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Heat cream in a bain-marie to 85 °C, stirring.
Add tartaric acid dissolved in lemon juice; hold 85 °C 5 min until it coats the spoon thickly.
Cool in an ice bath to 20 °C, stirring.
Pour into a fine cloth over a sieve; drain covered at 0–3 °C 12 h.
Whisk smooth; check: holds a peak; pack and label.
9a52488b.st: 0–3 °C, covered, 4 days; label date and batch.
9a52488b.al: 7 Milk (cream 35%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Bring milk and cream to a full boil, stirring.
Lower heat; add lemon juice with dissolved citric acid gradually until the curd breaks and whey turns clear.
Pour into a cloth-lined colander; rinse briefly with cold water to remove acidity.
Wrap tightly; press under 5 kg for 1 h in a mould 20 × 15 cm.
Unwrap; soak in ice water 30 min to firm; dry, portion 100 g.
f497ffc7.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 35%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Dissolve citric acid in the water.
Heat milk, cream and salt to 90 °C, stirring gently to avoid scorching.
Off the heat, add the acid in a thin stream; stir twice only; rest 10 min until curds separate and whey is clear yellow-green.
Ladle curds into a cheesecloth-lined colander; drain 15 min (soft, for desserts) to 1 h (firm, for filling).
Chill uncovered to below 5 °C within 90 min, then cover.
ea67fca4.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 20%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Whisk milk powder into cold milk; heat to 90 °C and hold 10 min (body and firm set).
Pour into sterilised jars or 150 g pots; cover.
Incubate 42–43 °C, undisturbed, 5–6 h to pH 4.5 and a firm set.
Chill at once to below 5 °C; do not stir.
7bbba43a.st: 0–3 °C 10 days; keep 100 g as starter for the next batch only within 3 days.
7bbba43a.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, skimmed milk powder, thermophilic yoghurt culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Heat cream to 85 °C for 10 min (denatures whey proteins for body); cool to 22 °C.
Whisk in culture; cover; ferment 22 °C 16–18 h to pH 4.5 and a spoonable set.
Chill undisturbed 8 h; stir gently; pack.
dc7f7af2.al: 7 Milk (cream 20%, mesophilic culture). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.

c: Line a perforated gastronorm with a double layer of cheesecloth; set over a deep tray.
Pour in yoghurt; cover; drain at 0–3 °C 10–12 h (about 55% loss).
Whisk smooth; check: holds its shape on a spoon.
Pack; keep the acid whey for brines, marinades or bread doughs (label, 3 days).
199e2e80.st: 0–3 °C, covered, 4 days; label date and batch.
199e2e80.al: 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%). Pasteurised milk only (non-UHT; non-homogenised preferred); log batch, temperatures and pH; dedicated sanitised equipment.
